defects.description: The lower bound is sample_id < 0, so 0 is accepted. R2 requires a positive integer, so the check must reject sample_id < 1.
make_label_batch enforces the lower bound count >= 1 only. The upper bound of 500 required by R4 is not enforced.
run_batch never calls register_labels, and the register_path parameter is unused. Generated labels are not written to the register CSV.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: The f-string yields STUDY-NNNNNN-YYYYMMDD with sample_id zero-padded to six digits and collected_at formatted as %Y%m%d, which is R1.
The length check against MAX_LABEL_LEN = 40 enforces R5. It looks redundant given the fixed format, but it is a required guard.
